tickets.title: Prepare college funding comparison for Dewspindle family
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of Nia Dewspindle’s 529 balance, the joint taxable brokerage assets, expected bonus cash, and a limited sale of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to cover the first‑year college funding gap while preserving the $80,000 cash reserve floor for Liora Dewspindle.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that by 2026-03-20 a comparison will be prepared of using Nia’s 529 balance, taxable brokerage assets, expected bonus cash, and a limited sale of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to cover the first-year college funding gap while preserving Liora’s stated cash reserve floor.

tickets.title: Select tuition payment method for Dewspindle family
tickets.text: Select the tuition payment method for Nia Dewspindle at Marzipan Meadow University, choosing between the semester lump‑sum payment or the monthly payment plan to enable the first bill processing.
tickets.evidence: tuition payment method selection is needed by 2026-04-15 because the Marzipan Meadow University portal offers a semester lump-sum payment or monthly payment plan, and the family has not chosen the method needed before the first bill can be processed.

tickets.title: Obtain current education account statements for Dewspindle children
tickets.text: Obtain the current statements for Nia Dewspindle’s 529 account, Owen Dewspindle’s 529 account, and the grandparent‑owned education account mentioned by Dorian Dewspindle, to confirm ownership, balances, and distribution options.
tickets.evidence: Current statements for Nia’s 529 account, Owen’s 529 account, and a grandparent-owned education account Dorian mentioned are needed by 2026-03-18 because the planning file lacks them and account ownership, balances, and available distribution options cannot be confirmed.

tickets.title: Reconcile Nia’s 529 balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the discrepancy between the $82,000 balance shown in Liora Dewspindle’s tuition spreadsheet and the $74,600 balance on the 529 portal statement for Nia Dewspindle, identifying the source of the difference.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the 529 balance by 2026-03-18 because Liora’s tuition spreadsheet lists Nia’s 529 balance at about $82,000, while the portal statement shows about $74,600 after a prior distribution, and the source of the difference was not identified during the call.

tickets.title: Review college cost worksheet for Dewspindle family
tickets.text: Review the college cost worksheet for Nia Dewspindle, clarifying allocation of scholarship aid, required technology costs, housing charges, and tuition to appropriate education account distributions and tax‑reporting records.
tickets.evidence: by 2026-03-24 the college cost worksheet will be reviewed because Elena’s review found scholarship aid, required technology costs, housing charges, and tuition grouped together, making it unclear which amounts should be matched to education account distributions and which records should be retained
